stories.s: Half a dozen elite British schools are chasing growth in India amid a boom in its wealthy population.
stories.tz: 英国顶尖名校进军印度以争夺生源和利润
stories.sz: 在印度富裕人口激增的背景下，数家英国精英学校正寻求在印度实现业务增长。

stories.t: Who actually controls Ukraine's access to Starlink?
stories.s: President Zelensky says limits to the technology continue to affect Ukrainian forces, while US officials and Elon Musk offer conflicting accounts of who controls it.
stories.tz: 究竟是谁在控制乌克兰对“星链”的使用权？
stories.sz: 泽连斯基总统表示，该技术的限制继续影响着乌克兰军队，而美国官员和埃隆·马斯克对谁拥有控制权则给出了相互矛盾的说法。

stories.t: Argentina drops investigation into President Milei over crypto fraud
stories.s: Javier Milei had denied acting fraudulently when a cryptocurrency nosedived after he deleted a social media post about it.
stories.tz: 阿根廷撤销对总统米莱涉嫌加密货币欺诈的调查
stories.sz: 此前，在米莱删除了一条关于某加密货币的社交媒体帖子后，该加密货币价格暴跌，米莱否认自己存在欺诈行为。

stories.t: Trump says US may launch ‘another little Epic Fury’ attack on Iran
stories.s: US President Donald Trump on Friday said his country may launch “another little Epic Fury” on Iran, referring to the joint Israeli-American military operation that sparked the war with Iran at the end of February.
stories.tz: 特朗普称美国可能对伊朗发动“又一次小型怒火狂飙”军事行动
stories.sz: 美国总统特朗普周五表示，美国可能会对伊朗发动“又一次小型怒火狂飙”行动，他指的是曾引发二月底对伊战争的以美联合军事行动。

stories.t: Building collapse in Nairobi search for survivors under way
stories.s: In tonight's programme, scramble to get through rubble to trapped survivors after a more than 10 storeys building being built in Nairobi goes down. Also, Kenya says that there's been a second Ebola death. Earlier this week it had logged 9…
stories.tz: 内罗毕发生楼房倒塌事故，搜救幸存者工作正在进行
stories.sz: 在今晚的节目中，内罗毕一座十多层在建楼房倒塌，搜救人员正紧急通过废墟搜寻被困幸存者。此外，肯尼亚称已出现第二例埃博拉死亡病例，本周早些时候该国已记录了9例……

stories.t: Freed US citizen was tortured in Russian jail, former Ukrainian prisoners say
stories.s: Ukrainians held alongside the American say they witnessed beatings and sexual humiliation by Russian guards during his detention.
stories.tz: 前乌克兰被关押人员称获释的美国公民在俄监狱中遭受酷刑
stories.sz: 曾与这名美国人一同被关押的乌克兰人表示，他们在关押期间目睹了俄罗斯狱警对其施加的殴打和性羞辱。

stories.t: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
stories.s: One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks. The suspected gunman has been apprehended.
stories.tz: 马克龙称巴黎近郊致命枪击事件为“种族主义恐怖袭击”
stories.sz: 一系列袭击造成一人死亡、五人受伤。疑似枪手已被抓获。

stories.t: Russia's attacks on Ukraine's capital, Kyiv, are intensifying. DW asked people on the ground what life is like
stories.s: Russia's attacks on the Ukrainian capital are hitting harder and more frequently, making 2026 one of the long war's bloodiest years for Kyiv. DW asked people on the ground what life is like.
stories.tz: 俄罗斯对乌克兰首都基辅的攻击加剧，德国之声询问当地民众生活状况
stories.sz: 俄罗斯对乌克兰首都的打击力度更大、频率更高，使2026年成为这场漫长战争中对基辅而言最血腥的年份之一。德国之声向当地民众了解了他们的生活状况。

stories.t: Ukraine says Starlink still restricted after Trump says limits lifted
stories.s: The network is used by the Ukrainian military, sources say, and Trump says "if there is a problem, I'll get it straightened out".
stories.tz: 乌克兰称特朗普宣布解除限制后星链仍受限制
stories.sz: 消息人士称，在多次否认有意放慢速度后，乌克兰军方使用的网络仍存在问题。

stories.t: Trump administration sues to block certification of upcoming Alaska election
stories.s: The justice department has filed a lawsuit arguing that the inclusion of two candidates named Dan Sullivan could confuse voters.
stories.tz: 特朗普政府提起诉讼，要求阻止认证即将到来的阿拉斯加选举结果
stories.sz: 美国司法部已提起诉讼，称候选人中出现两个名叫丹·沙利文的人可能会迷惑选民。

stories.t: Israel launches collective punishment campaign in Hebron after two soldiers killed
stories.s: Benjamin Netanyahu and ministers promise demolitions and forced displacement after deadly gunfight Israel has launched a campaign of collective punishment against Palestinians in Hebron after gunmen killed two Israeli soldiers and injured…
stories.tz: 两名士兵被杀后，以色列在希伯伦发起集体惩罚行动
stories.sz: 在发生导致以色列士兵伤亡的致命枪战后，内塔尼亚胡及各位部长承诺实施房屋拆除和强制驱逐。以色列已对希伯伦的巴勒斯坦人发起集体惩罚行动……

stories.t: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
stories.s: The soldiers were killed in an attack by two Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint outside the West Bank city on Friday morning.
stories.tz: 两名以色列士兵遭枪杀后，以军开始拆除希伯伦的巴勒斯坦建筑
stories.sz: 周五上午，两名巴勒斯坦枪手在约旦河西岸城市外的一个检查站发动袭击，导致士兵身亡。

stories.t: Oil spill washes up on UAE beaches after tanker strike
stories.s: Satellite images show oil spreading for miles along the coastline, threatening local marine wildlife
stories.tz: 油轮遭袭后，石油泄漏漂至阿联酋海滩
stories.sz: 卫星图像显示，原油在海岸线沿线扩散数英里，对当地海洋野生动物构成威胁

stories.t: Home distillers rejoice as US Supreme Court considers whether to finally legalise moonshine
stories.s: The Supreme Court will consider in the new year whether the 1868 legislation forbidding home distilling should be overturned.
stories.tz: 美国最高法院考虑是否将私酿烈酒合法化
stories.sz: 最高法院将于新年审议是否推翻1868年禁止在家酿酒的法律。

stories.t: US justice department investigating Corey Lewandowski over DHS role
stories.s: Trump's former campaign manager is reportedly being investigated for allegedly using his role at the Department of Homeland for financial gain.
stories.tz: 美国司法部正就科里·莱万多夫斯基的国土安全部职务对其进行调查
stories.sz: 据报道，特朗普的前竞选经理因涉嫌利用其在国土安全部的职务谋取经济利益而正接受调查。

stories.t: Afghan women could lose one of their last paths to a higher education
stories.s: The US has defunded one of the last universities giving Afghan women the chance to receive an education after the Taliban takeover in 2021. DW spoke with a student who says she's lost hope of ever earning a degree.
stories.tz: 阿富汗女性可能失去接受高等教育的最后途径之一
stories.sz: 在塔利班于2021年接管政权后，美国停止资助为阿富汗女性提供教育机会的最后几所大学之一。德国之声采访了一名学生，她表示自己已经对获得学位失去了希望。

stories.t: Ukraine tries to shut Moscow's airports with drone strikes on Russia
stories.s: Repeated Ukrainian drone attacks are increasingly disrupting operations at Moscow's airports. The pounding is part of Ukraine's plan to shut down Russia's airpace.
stories.tz: 乌克兰对俄发动无人机袭击，试图关闭莫斯科机场
stories.sz: 乌克兰近期频繁发动无人机袭击，对莫斯科各机场的运营造成日益严重的干扰。此举是乌克兰关闭俄罗斯领空计划的一部分。

stories.t: Mystery over source of Ebola infection in Nigeria fuels concern about spread of virus
stories.s: Switzerland says patient is wife of Swiss diplomat and believed to have contracted virus while travelling in Uganda Health officials across Africa are racing to determine how Nigeria’s first Ebola patient ⁠in more than a decade ⁠became…
stories.tz: 尼德利亚埃博拉感染源成谜，引发对病毒传播的担忧
stories.sz: 瑞士表示，患者是一名瑞士外交官的妻子，据信她在乌干达旅行期间感染了病毒。全非洲的卫生官员正争分夺秒地查明尼日利亚十多年来的首例埃博拉患者是如何感染的……

stories.t: Japan-Russia ties erode as journalist sits in Moscow jail
stories.s: Japan is demanding access to a journalist who was arrested by Russian security services. The Kremlin claims that Japan is using journalists as spies.
stories.tz: 一名记者被关押在莫斯科监狱，日俄关系进一步恶化
stories.sz: 日本正要求探视一名被俄罗斯安全部门逮捕的记者。莫斯科则声称东京正利用记者充当间谍。

stories.t: Authorities investigating whether first Kenya and Nigeria Ebola cases crossed paths
stories.s: Nigeria this week recorded its first case of Ebola in the current outbreak, which has spread from the epicenter in Congo to several other African countries.
stories.tz: 当局正在调查肯尼亚和尼日利亚的首例埃博拉病例是否有交集
stories.sz: 尼日利亚本周记录了本轮疫情中的首例埃博拉病例。此次疫情已从刚果（金）的震中蔓延至其他几个非洲国家。

stories.t: Denmark to ban mink farming in government U-turn
stories.s: Once the world's largest producer of mink pelts, the nation's industry has declined in recent years.
stories.tz: 丹麦政府政策大转弯，将全面禁止水貂养殖
stories.sz: 该国曾是全球最大的水貂皮生产国，但近年来其水貂产业已走向衰落。

stories.t: Uganda says it has no active Ebola cases, but infections in Kenya and Nigeria are prompting fresh scrutiny
stories.s: Health officials are investigating whether Ebola patients in Kenya and Nigeria crossed paths at Uganda's main airport as conflicting accounts cloud the source of one infection.
stories.tz: 乌干达称无现存埃博拉病例，但肯尼亚和尼日利亚的感染病例引发新一轮审查
stories.sz: 由于对其中一起感染源的说法存在冲突，卫生官员正在调查肯尼亚和尼日利亚的埃博拉患者是否在乌干达的主机场有过交集。

stories.t: Serbia: Hope, tension and apprehension as voters prepare to elect new parliament
stories.s: After two years of protests, Serbia faces a pivotal election on Sunday, with a student-led challenge to Aleksandar Vucic's lengthy rule. Allegations of electoral irregularities and fears of a post-election crisis abound.
stories.tz: 塞尔维亚举行新一届议会选举：选民怀揣希望、紧张与不安
stories.sz: 经过两年的抗议活动，塞尔维亚于周日迎来一场至关重要的选举，面临着学生主导对亚历山大·武契奇长期统治的挑战。选举不公的指控以及对选举后危机的担忧甚嚣尘上。

stories.t: Doctors tell the BBC about the targeting of Sudanese hospitals by paramilitary fighters
stories.s: A BBC investigation has found evidence that Sudanese paramilitary fighters systematically destroyed el-Fasher's healthcare system.
stories.tz: 医生向BBC透露苏丹准军事武装蓄意袭击苏丹医院
stories.sz: BBC的一项调查发现证据表明，苏丹准军事武装系统性地摧毁了法希尔的医疗系统。

stories.t: Military reinforcements move to Mideast. And, millions of Americans vote early
stories.s: Military reinforcements are heading to the Middle East and some personnel have left the region, pointing to a potential attack on Iran. And, millions of Americans have already voted in the midterms.
stories.tz: 军事增援部队向中东调动，数百万美国人提前投票
stories.sz: 军事增援部队正前往中东，部分人员已离开该地区，这表明可能对伊朗发动攻击。此外，已有数百万美国人在中期选举中提前投票。

stories.t: Malawi opposition demands answers over president's prolonged stay abroad
stories.s: This is President Peter Mutharika's fifth visit to South Africa this year.
stories.tz: 马拉维反对派要求对总统长期滞留海外作出解释
stories.sz: 这是总统彼得·穆塔里卡今年第五次访问南非。

stories.t: Retired general discusses the U.S. and Israeli plan for possible attack on Iran
stories.s: NPR'S Leila Fadel speaks with retired four-star Gen. Joseph Votel about the war in Iran and the U.S. and Israeli objectives for a potential post-election bombing campaign.
stories.tz: 退休将军讨论美以针对伊朗潜在袭击计划
stories.sz: NPR的莱拉·法德尔采访了退役四星上将约瑟夫·沃特尔，探讨了伊朗战争以及美以对大选后潜在轰炸行动的目标。

stories.t: Hospitals deliberately targeted by Sudan's RSF fighters, BBC finds
stories.s: The UN human rights chief Volker Türk says the multiple attacks may amount to war crimes.
stories.tz: BBC调查发现苏丹快速支援部队蓄意袭击医院
stories.sz: 联合国人权事务高级专员福尔克尔·蒂尔克表示，这些多起袭击可能构成战争罪。

stories.t: Woman with Ebola in Nigeria confirmed as wife of Swiss diplomat
stories.s: Her husband is currently in isolation but has not developed any symptoms, Swiss officials say.
stories.tz: 尼日利亚埃博拉病毒感染女性被证实为瑞士外交官妻子
stories.sz: 瑞士官员称，她的丈夫目前正在隔离中，但尚未出现任何症状。

stories.t: Israel orders closure of West Bank after soldiers kill 2 men behind an alleged attack
stories.s: Israeli soldiers shot and killed two men who the military said had launched an attack near the city of Hebron in the occupied West Bank on Friday morning. At least five people were injured, including some critically.
stories.tz: 以色列士兵枪杀两名涉嫌袭击者后下令封锁约旦河西岸
stories.sz: 周五上午，以色列士兵开枪打死了两名男子，军方称他们在被占领的约旦河西岸希伯伦市附近发动了袭击。事件造成至少五人受伤，其中数人伤势严重。

stories.t: Sri Lanka: Death of iconic elephant raises habitat concerns
stories.s: The death of what was thought to be Sri Lanka’s largest elephant has drawn attention to human-elephant conflict in rural communities. The island country sees a high number of deadly encounters.
stories.tz: 斯里兰卡标志性大象之死引发对其栖息地的担忧
stories.sz: 斯里兰卡被认为体型最大的一头大象的死亡，再次引发人们对农村地区人象冲突的关注。该岛国频繁发生致命的人象遭遇事件。

stories.t: Hispanic voters helped bring Trump to power - in Texas, the tide may be turning
stories.s: Recent polls suggest the president is facing challenging headwinds in the state ahead of the midterms.
stories.tz: 拉美裔选民助力特朗普上台，而在得克萨斯州风向可能正在转变
stories.sz: 近期民调显示，在中期选举到来之前，这位总统在该州面临着严峻的逆风。

stories.t: Brazil's runoff: Lula's legacy vs. Bolsonaro's dynasty
stories.s: Brazil's tight presidential runoff pits a political giant against a Bolsonaro heir in a battle over the country's political future.
stories.tz: 巴西决选：卢拉的政治遗产对决博索纳罗家族
stories.sz: 巴西紧张的总统选举决选在一位政治巨头与博索纳罗的继承人之间展开，这是一场关乎该国政治未来的较量。

stories.t: Hundreds of flights cancelled as Typhoon Champi shuts Taiwan
stories.s: One person has died after being swept away by waves in Taiwan's Liuqiu island, authorities say.
stories.tz: 台风“灿品”致台湾关停，数百个航班被取消
stories.sz: 据当局称，台湾琉球屿有一人被海浪卷走不幸身亡。

stories.t: Rubio turns to small Indian town as US faces high oil prices
stories.s: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio pushed a business and energy agenda over diplomacy on his second trip to India this year.
stories.tz: 面对高油价，鲁比奥访问印度小镇寻求合作
stories.sz: 美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥今年对印度进行了第二次访问，其间他将重点放在商业和能源议程上，而非外交。

stories.t: The Indian workers filming their work to train AI
stories.s: Indian workers are being paid to film themselves at work and the footage is used to train AI.
stories.tz: 印度工人拍摄自己的工作视频以训练人工智能
stories.sz: 印度工人获得报酬来拍摄自己工作的视频，这些镜头素材正被用于训练人工智能。

stories.t: Magnitude-7 earthquake hits Tibet, killing at least 16 and destroying hundreds of homes
stories.s: Search and rescue efforts under way after quake strikes region’s north, with at least seven aftershocks recorded A magnitude-7 earthquake has hit Tibet, killing at least 16 people, injuring 54 and destroying hundreds of homes in the…
stories.tz: 西藏发生7.0级地震，已致至少16人死亡、数百栋房屋被毁
stories.sz: 西藏北部发生地震后，搜救工作正在进行，已记录到至少7次余震。西藏发生7.0级地震，造成至少16人死亡、54人受伤，数百栋房屋被毁……

stories.t: India slashes cost of cancer drugs after court rules mark-ups are ‘extortion’
stories.s: Case filed in 2022 by patient unable to afford medicine leads to cap on drug prices for millions who face ruin if diagnosed The Indian government has moved to reduce the price of cancer drugs after a retired bank clerk took her case to the…
stories.tz: 法院裁定加价属“敲诈”，印度大幅削减抗癌药价格
stories.sz: 一名无力承担药费的患者于2022年提起诉讼，促使政府为数百万面临因病致贫风险的民众设定了药品价格上限。在一位退休银行职员提起诉讼后，印度政府采取行动降低抗癌药物价格……

stories.t: Why a student protest movement is challenging 12 years of Vučić rule in Serbia
stories.s: After two years of student protests, Serbians vote on Sunday in elections that could bring down the ruling party.
stories.tz: 为什么学生抗议运动正在挑战塞尔维亚武契奇12年的统治
stories.sz: 经过两年的学生抗议，塞尔维亚人将于周日进行投票，这场选举可能会令执政党倒台。

stories.t: Powerful earthquake hits Tibet killing 16 people, reports say
stories.s: The quake hit a mountainous, sparsely-populated area in what China calls the Tibet Autonomous Region.
stories.tz: 据报道，西藏发生强震造成16人死亡
stories.sz: 地震袭击了中国所称的西藏自治区内一个多山且人口稀少的地区。
